memorial.name: Harold
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: A stranger. 13 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Dominic
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. The wild. 36 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Camila
memorial.epitaph: Well. The wild. 24 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Andres
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. The night. 13 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Aroha
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 11 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Yara
